Over 140,000 gross tonnage $0.05 or its peso equivalent every excess tonnage. Rate for docking and
undocking anchorage, conduction and shifting and other related special services is equal to 100%. Pilotage

services shall be compulsory in government and private wharves or piers.

With respect to foreign vessels, payment of pilotage services shall be made in dollars or in pesos at the
prevailing exchange rate.

All dollars, letters of instruction, rules, regulations and other issuances inconsistent with this Executive
Order are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
